subject: Matemática
description_pt: Classificar e comparar figuras planas (triângulo, quadrado, retângulo, trapézio e paralelogramo) em relação a seus lados (quantidade, posições relativas e comprimento) e vértices.

components.description_pt: Classificar figuras planas por número de lados: triângulos, quadrados, retângulos, trapézios e paralelogramos
components.description_en: Classify plane figures (triangles, squares, rectangles, trapezoids, and parallelograms) by number of sides
components.cc_component_description: Use defining attributes to identify two-dimensional shapes such as triangles, squares, rectangles, and trapezoids.

components.description_pt: Classificar figuras bidimensionais pela presença ou ausência de linhas perpendiculares ou paralelas
components.description_en: Classify two-dimensional figures based on the presence or absence of perpendicular or parallel lines
components.cc_component_description: Classify two-dimensional figures based on the presence or absence of perpendicular or parallel lines

components.description_pt: Comparar figuras planas pelos comprimentos de seus lados
components.description_en: Compare plane figures by the lengths of their sides
components.cc_component_description: Analyze and compare two- and three-dimensional shapes, in different sizes and orientations, using informal language to describe their similarities, differences, parts (e.g., number of sides and vertices/"corners") and other attributes (e.g., having sides of equal length).

components.description_pt: Classificar figuras planas pelo número e características de seus vértices
components.description_en: Classify plane figures by the number and characteristics of their vertices
components.cc_component_description: Correctly name shapes regardless of their size

cc_matches.description: Classify two-dimensional figures based on the presence or absence of parallel or perpendicular lines, or the presence or absence of angles of a specified size. Recognize right triangles as a category, and identify right triangles.
Correctly name shapes regardless of their orientations or overall size.

Distinguish between defining attributes (e.g., triangles are closed and three-sided) versus non-defining attributes (e.g., color, orientation, overall size); build and draw shapes to possess defining attributes.

Analyze and compare two- and three-dimensional shapes, in different sizes and orientations, using informal language to describe their similarities, differences, parts (e.g., number of sides and vertices/"corners") and other attributes (e.g., having sides of equal length).
